subject.title: Clarify and harden the A.I.G scanner integration

question: Does the merged local `aig-skill-scan` migration intentionally replace the service-backed A.I.G workflow requested here, including its setup and safety expectations?
rationale: The merged work changes the integration model rather than implementing the original sidecar/service plan verbatim, and collaborator-authored items require explicit maintainer judgment before closure.
